description: Acquires and reconciles current USPS PostalPro Area/District and AISU ZIP files as governed optional supplemental routing evidence.

usps_operational_zip_evidence.included_semantics: ZIP5 appears in the current USPS Area/District assignment file; this is routing evidence, not polygon geometry or address-level deliverability.

permission_reference.description: Non-secret permission record identifier required for usps-written-permission.

retry: No automatic retry in version 1.0.0; an operator can rerun after a transient failure without publishing partial state.
checkpoint: All files are acquired into an immutable run staging directory; no current pointer is changed until validation and publication complete.
idempotency: Source storage month and checksums identify content; releases remain immutable even when content is reacquired.
cancellation: An AbortSignal cancels page and file requests; staged partial state is never published.
retention_profile: USPS source and derived record-level artifacts remain local and ignored by Git unless a reviewed written permission explicitly authorizes another treatment.
